Kai (Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: a customer asked if we can produce auditor-friendly proof that audit logs weren't tampered with and show KMS rotations. Short answer?

Nora (Security): Yes. We can generate an evidence bundle that includes batch chain-hashes (tamper-evidence), signed rotation events, and an integration log with KMS/HSM references. For BYOK we record key ARNs/grants and the signing call metadata; we do NOT store plaintext key material.

Lina (Product): Product note: Console -> Security -> Audit -> "Create evidence bundle" is planned as a beta next quarter so customers can self-serve the download. Bundles can be exported to a customer S3 or temporary secure URL.

Marta (Privacy): Heads up: if bundles include PII or retention >12 months, legal/privacy review required (region-specific). We'll add DSAR/redaction guidance to the docs.

Kai (Eng): Any quick CLI example to request a bundle?

Nora (Security): Example snippet:
```
redwoodctl audit bundle create --deployment dp-001 --start 2024-01-01 --end 2024-12-31 --include-rotations --output s3://cust-evidence
```
We'll add full flags and RBAC notes to the docs.
